faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the AYCL Officer/Asst. Manager/Dy. Manager (Personnel & Administration) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form for the AYCL Officer/Asst. Manager/Dy. Manager (Personnel & Administration) posts is 04 October 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies released by AYCL?
faq.answer: Andrew Yule & Company Limited (AYCL) has released a total of 1 vacancy for the post of Officer/Asst. Manager/Dy. Manager (Personnel & Administration).

faq.question: Q3. What is the required educational qualification for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must be a Graduate with a Post Graduate Degree/Diploma (2 years) in Human Resource Management/Personnel Management/Industrial Relations/Labour Welfare/MSW to be eligible.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit for the applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the applicants is 42 years, with age relaxation applicable as per Government norms for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary structure for the selected candidates?
faq.answer: The salary structure varies based on the level: E1 (₹40,000-₹1,40,000), E2 (₹50,000-₹1,60,000), and E3 (₹60,000-₹1,80,000).

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, the official notification states that there is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST).

faq.question: Q7. How can candidates apply for the AYCL recruitment?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply online through the official AYCL website or the direct application link provided in the Important Links section.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the AYCL Officer/Asst. Manager/Dy. Manager (Personnel & Administration) posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for these posts will be based on an Interview.
